meta.title: Hugo Fugeard · Private chef in the Alps and Annecy
meta.description: Private chef in ski chalets in winter: Courchevel, Méribel, Megève, Val d'Isère, Verbier and Gstaad. All year round, private chef in and around Annecy for dinners and events. Made-to-measure cooking inspired by the whole Mediterranean basin.

hero.eyebrow: Private chef · French and Swiss Alps · Annecy
hero.title: Your private chef, wherever you are.
hero.text: In winter, find me in private chalets: Courchevel, Méribel, Megève, Val d'Isère, Verbier, Gstaad. The rest of the year, in your holiday rentals and in your own home: Annecy and the surrounding area. Made-to-measure cooking, made from the heart and served at your table.
hero.imageAlt: Hugo Fugeard, private chef, in his black chef's jacket in the kitchen

about.title: My values:
paragraphs: In a chalet in the French and Swiss Alps or in Annecy and the surrounding area, so all you have to do is enjoy.

values.title: Discretion
values.text: What happens at your table stays at your table. Total confidentiality: no photo, no name disclosed.

values.title: Rigour
values.text: No middleman: I cook for you personally, from the first meal to the last.

values.title: Generosity
values.text: Comforting, sincere cooking, made from the heart.

about.quote: French and Italian are the cuisines I love most: exceptional fresh produce, authentic flavours, from the great classics to more refined plates. Other cravings? Let's talk!
about.imageAlt: Hugo Fugeard cooking in a chalet kitchen, in his black chef's jacket

approach.title: My work
approach.intro: Every family and every place is different. I adapt to every situation.

items.title: Family style
items.text: Starters and mains in the middle of the table: everyone helps themselves as they like, in a warm, family spirit.

items.title: Plated
items.text: French-style service and precise plating: colour, texture, perfect cooking, sauces, seasonality.

items.title: Made for you
items.text: Your tastes, allergies, dietary needs, the children's favourite dishes. We design the menu together, so every guest feels fully taken care of.

process.title: How it works
process.intro: From the first contact to dessert.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.text: Tell me where, when and how many people.

steps.title: Your menu proposal
steps.text: I send you a personal proposal for each day and each meal, which we approve together.

steps.title: A deposit
steps.text: A deposit confirms your dates and makes your booking binding.

steps.title: The shopping
steps.text: I don't pay for the shopping upfront.

steps.title: We check together
steps.text: All the shopping is checked against the receipts.

steps.title: Payment
steps.text: Payment at the end of the service, on presentation of the invoice.

items.question: What does a private chef actually do?
items.answer: I come to your house or holiday rental and cook for you during your stay. I cook on site and serve at the table.

items.question: Do you travel outside France?
items.answer: Yes. In winter I mostly work in resorts in the French and Swiss Alps. On request, I'm happy to travel abroad for the length of the booking.

items.question: How many guests can you cook for?
Allergies, diets, picky kids?
items.answer: Of course. Tell me about allergies, what you don't like and the children's habits when we plan the menu, so every guest feels fully taken care of.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: I work on a flat-fee basis: a daily rate for chalet stays, and a fee per lunch or dinner in and around Annecy. You know the price in advance, with no surprises. The shopping isn't included: I don't pay for it upfront, and we check it together at the end with the receipts. Send me your dates, the place and the number of guests, and I'll reply with your proposal.

items.question: How much is the deposit?
items.answer: The deposit is 25% of the total quote. It confirms your dates, which are then reserved for you.

items.question: What kind of cooking do you offer?
items.answer: I master the cooking of the whole Mediterranean basin, from France to Italy, from Spain to Greece. That is the world I draw on to create your made-to-measure menus. Asian cooking, for example, isn't my field.
